central_result: A conductance assembled from one microphysical event and its PT-reversed partner is symmetric before any matrix-level repair.  Photon number, BE equilibrium, free-energy dissipation, and photon-atom four-force cancellation then follow edge by edge.
limitations: The prototype uses a scalar Rayleigh-like amplitude rather than the full hydrogen KHW amplitude.
The atom kinematics are nonrelativistic in the prototype, although energy and momentum are exactly enforced within that model.
Frequency cells are represented by nodes rather than event-deposited finite-volume integrals.
Polarization, J-state interference, and atomic alignment are not included.
The artifact validates architecture and invariants, not production Ly-alpha rates.

next_stage.name: C2d2C1_physical_frequency_angle_event_pair
tasks: Replace the toy event graph by the COM-resolved scalar KHW event integrand.
Use Lebedev angular cells and the immutable v0.3 frequency cells shifted to the absorption anchor.
Deposit each forward event and its PT partner into the same unordered conductance edge.
Keep full angle indices and run dipole, quadrupole, and direction-dependent red/blue-crossing tests.
Generate photon and hydrogen four-force from the same edge fluxes.
Require raw event-pair conductance symmetry before adding fine structure or polarization.
